caption: The video showcases a black plastic tray resting on a flat pink surface, holding purple crystalline formations. Two pale white mounds sit within the mold, each capped with a cluster of glittering violet crystals that spread across the rim and the glossy purple liquid pooling at the base. The tray sits at a slight angle, its ridged interior catching soft reflections from the overhead light. The dim, out-of-focus background draws attention to the vivid purple growth against the bright pink mat. Throughout the excerpt, the crystal arrangement, the tray position, and the lighting all remain unchanged, offering a steady view of the settled formations. The scene holds this fixed composition without visible movement or alteration from the first frame to the last.
